correctness.rationale: Anisotropy gives orthogonal complements for every subspace and hence an explicit Moore-Penrose inverse for every endomorphism. Isotropy gives an explicit rank-one triple ABC=0 with ACB non-Moore-Penrose because its image is a degenerate isotropic line.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Classical *-regular and generalized-inverse results are prior art and not claimed. The inspected 2026 source asks whether Condition (3) implies Condition (4); targeted searches did not locate the adjoint-ring anisotropy equivalence. Two older matrix generalized-inverse papers were not independently inspected in full and remain residual risks.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a sharp affirmative answer to the source question on a broad canonical class of simple Artinian *-rings and yields a complete finite-field classification for transpose involutions.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
